The server log shows nothing about any client requests. That's very strange! The nginx is serving the static files from `/opt/areloria/client/dist` directly without touching the server.

Wait - there's a problem with my nginx config. Let me check nginx access logs to see what happens when I request the site:

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check nginx access log
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -30 /var/log/nginx/access.log")
print("Nginx access:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
